cards.card_text: They search all over Israel for a beautiful girl and find Abishag the Shunammite.
cards.verse_text: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.
cards.snippet: …searched throughout Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.

cards.card_text: So Bathsheba goes to see the king in his bedroom, where Abishag the Shunammite is serving him.
cards.verse_text: Since the king was very old, Abishag the Shunammite was serving him.
cards.snippet: Since the king was very old, Abishag the Shunammite was serving him.

cards.card_text: Abishag the Shunammite as his wife Command over the king's whole army A city of his own to rule over
cards.verse_text: Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”
cards.snippet: Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”

cards.card_text: So Bathsheba asks for Abishag the Shunammite to be given to Adonijah as his wife.
cards.verse_text: So Bathsheba said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.” King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah?
cards.snippet: So Bathsheba said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.” King Solomon answered…

cards.card_text: Then Elisha has Gehazi call the Shunammite woman, and when she comes he says, “Pick up your son.”
cards.verse_text: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman.” So he called her and she came.
cards.snippet: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman.” So he called her and she came.
